queries.query: why did the primordial kings of Edom die before creation could stand, and how was the restored world built out of the wreck of the world that was destroyed
queries.note: The dead Edomite kings and the equilibrium of balance (Siphra Dtzenioutha ch. I); 'countenance beheld not countenance', 'their crowns were found no more', 'the earth was desolate' paraphrased away; 'Edom' kept as a name any Zohar reader knows.

queries.query: the great dragon coiled about the lower emanations of the queen on every side, whose demonic realm mirrors the Sephiroth in inverted form, kept concealed until justice requires a destroyer
queries.note: The serpent and the shells in Mathers' commentary; 'Qlipoth', 'distorted and averse', 'encompasseth the seven inferior emanations after the manner of a serpent', the leviathan and watch-wheel comparisons paraphrased away; corpus-native 'Sephiroth' spelling kept.

queries.query: why must opposing forces be held in balance for a world to exist at all
queries.note: Equilibrium versus the two scales of the balance; cosmic polarity is answered across many traditions. No target — graded post-hoc.
